text.en:
Section 3 of the Presidential Decree No. 260 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. To carry out purposes of this Decree the sum of five hundred thousand pesos (P500,000.00) for the
National Museum and the same amount for the National Historical Commission are hereby appropriated from
the General Fund not otherwise appropriated beginning July 1, 1974. Such amount the subsequent fiscal
year's budgets.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed and/or
modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 28th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-four.
